classifier_scope.question: Which pieces of Tr(Delta^-1 delta2 Delta) may be removed by a predetermined local subtraction scheme?
allowed_local_data: UV heat-kernel/asymptotic coefficients fixed before low-shell matrix evaluation
local curvature, metric-strain, and volume counterterms with coefficients fixed by the chosen Maxwell--ghost scheme
scheme constants that do not depend on the finite n=1 or n=3 projection values
forbidden_subtractions: post-hoc removal of finite low-shell spectral traces
direction-dependent subtraction tuned after seeing C_delta2[A,B]
erasing the trace80 n=1<->n=3 obstruction by declaring it local
using a finite counterterm to force N_need to equal 10

local_heat_kernel_part.required_proof: show dependence only on local invariants of the ambient path and fixed scheme coefficients

finite_low_shell_part.role: quotient-normalized spectral data from n=1 and n=3 diagonal C_delta2 blocks
finite_low_shell_part.required_proof: compute or prove exact compensation; not removable by local counterterms

scheme_compensation_part.role: possible cancellation against ghost/exact/normalization blocks inside the same determinant scheme
scheme_compensation_part.required_proof: derive coefficient-level compensation before comparing with alpha

decision_rule.if: a term is a predetermined local heat-kernel coefficient
decision_rule.then: it may be subtracted only according to the declared scheme

decision_rule.if: a term depends on finite low-shell projections or C_delta2 matrix entries
decision_rule.then: it must remain in the determinant trace unless exact compensation is derived

decision_rule.if: the local/nonlocal split cannot be proven
decision_rule.then: compute the finite C_delta2 diagonal blocks and keep the residual in the master matrix

pass_fail.meaning: The local, finite-low-shell, and scheme-compensation buckets are now separated.
No proof yet that delta2 Delta contributes only predetermined local heat-kernel data.
No C_delta2 finite residual table has been computed.
No ghost/exact/normalization compensation has been derived in the same Maxwell--ghost scheme.

plain_language: The sixth gear is the trash sorter. It says what is harmless local dust and what is a real low-shell stone that cannot be swept away after we see it.
verdict: The local-counterterm classifier for delta2 Delta_1 is now fixed at skeleton level. Predetermined heat-kernel/local pieces may be subtracted only by a declared scheme, while finite low-shell C_delta2 data and the trace80-type obstruction cannot be removed by post-hoc finite counterterms. This does not prove locality or compensation; it fixes the rule that missing finite residuals must be computed and kept unless exact same-scheme cancellation is derived.
